description: This is a PHP source file defining the ChimeSDKMessagingClient class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to messaging channels, such as creating, deleting, describing, and listing channels, as well as managing channel membership and messages.

classes.name: ChimeSDKMessagingClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Amazon Chime SDK Messaging service, extends AwsClient.

methods.name: associateChannelFlow
methods.description: Associates a channel flow with a messaging channel.

methods.name: batchCreateChannelMembership
methods.description: Adds multiple members to a channel in a batch operation.

methods.name: describeChannel
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific channel.

methods.name: listChannels
methods.description: Lists all channels associated with the account.

methods.name: sendChannelMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a specified channel.

methods.name: tagResource
methods.description: Tags a resource with key-value pairs.
